We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR data perhaps. We can request proton NMR spectra (which will show methyl signals). Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (requires SMILES? It says for a given SMILES string. But we don't have SMILES. Maybe we have sample at hand? The tools carbon_nmr_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, hsqc_nmr_spectra take no arguments. They likely operate on the sample at hand (unknown). So we can call proton_nmr_spectra to get 1H NMR. Then count methyl peaks (singlet, doublet, triplet around 0.9-1.5 ppm). Could also use carbon NMR to see number of methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). Simpler: get carbon NMR and count signals in that region.

Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
